## Bounded reusable procedure

1. Read the content/layout request, check exact hashes, and create working copies. Keep original/reference/v2/v3 files outside every write target. Start with `START.json`, then bounded route/capability/api lookups. The current task used `page-layout`, native section/page capability, `SaveAs`, and `SummaryInfo`; existing S-guidanceF/S-copyF and the owned COM adapter supplied the relevant native patterns. Do not search or mutate separate rubric/experiment work.
2. Create a fresh `HWPFrame.HwpObject`; resolve `XHwpWindows.Item(0).WindowHandle` with `GetWindowThreadProcessId`. Require a nonzero Hwp PID absent from the existing-process baseline before any Open/Visible/Quit action. Never attach with `GetActiveObject`. Quit only the owned process. This task's two native jobs both had empty preexisting Hwp baselines and independently owned PIDs 18688 and 35792.
3. Open a reference working copy and export native HWPX/PDF for structural and visual inspection. Read actual paper, margins, columns, headers, rules, question starts, choice flow and spacing before selecting a template. Do not infer a reference template from the content document or filename.
4. Resolve complete question tables through source-owned bindings. Move those envelopes out of obsolete page tables rather than transcribing text, recreating equations or rendering diagrams again. Change only layout envelopes and the necessary paragraph styles. Preserve equation scripts, base units, measured sizes/baselines/margins, image payloads and embeddings, and nested proof/example/blank tables. Keep `secPr` and `colPr` in the initial paragraph.
5. When native whole-question transfer is needed across unrelated style/media environments, use the verified selected-table `GetTextFile("HWPML2X", "saveblock")` / `SetTextFile(..., "HWPML2X", "insertfile")` path. This task reused the v3 package environment and exact question subtrees directly, so no clipboard transfer or old scratch document was needed.
6. Set the document title with native `DocSummaryInfo` using an explicit action parameter set. Set the package's `opf:title` for reusable authoring as well; the native title readback is authoritative. Save with explicit `HWP`, clear the owned document, reopen the actual delivered HWP, and export the PDF from that reopened HWP. Do not rename a ZIP/HWPX to `.hwp`.
7. Perform one proportionate final readback. Compare per-question mixed text/math/image token order, Korean text, all scripts, exact equation metrics, per-question picture hashes, choices and nested controls. Check both CFB magic and `HWP Document File` signature. Compare native page/margin/column values and inspect all-page contact sheets plus sensitive changed regions. Repeat only for a real defect or invalidated evidence.
